thread:
mira: Heads up — customer ac-998 reported an unexplained token bump after a resumed stream that got routed through broker-2. +1.2k tokens for a ~200-token continuation :confused:

alex: Any IDs? thinking this smells like a commit race between router handoff and ledger commit.

mira: session=rc-7f9a2, route=eu-west-2/broker-2, root_ts=1768309999

ops-bot: [alert] provisional-billing anomaly for ac-998, delta=+1243 tokens, detected=2026-03-16T11:21:05Z

sam: I reproduced with our disconnect+reconnect harness while prefetch is enabled. Prefetch queues a suffix chunk; the handoff triggers a resume path that also issues a commit for the same suffix as a separate toolcall.

alex: So the suffix gets committed twice — once before handoff, once after resume? :thinking_face:

mira: Exactly. Router enqueues suffix -> handoff midstream -> broker resumes and issues a new commit_id. Ledger dedupe keys on commit_id, so a new id equals a new charge.

tanvi: Console trace shows the broker-2 per-route token bar spike aligning with the reconnect window. Two commit events back-to-back in the timeline.

mira: Router log (sanitized):
```
2026-03-16T11:20:58Z INFO route=broker-2 session=rc-7f9a2 action=prefetch queued_suffix_len=320
2026-03-16T11:21:03Z WARN route=broker-2 session=rc-7f9a2 action=handoff state=midstream
2026-03-16T11:21:05Z INFO route=broker-2 session=rc-7f9a2 action=commit tokens=320 commit_id=cid-abc123
2026-03-16T11:21:06Z INFO route=broker-2 session=rc-7f9a2 action=resume resume_token=rt-77 cause=reconnect
2026-03-16T11:21:07Z INFO route=broker-2 session=rc-7f9a2 action=commit tokens=320 commit_id=cid-def456
```

sam: That second commit_id is the issue. ledger dedupe only sees commit ids, not range overlap. Resume path creates a fresh commit_id.

alex: What are quick mitigations? Either: 1) Make resume reuse original commit_id when suffix matches, or 2) Extend ledger to dedupe overlapping ranges irrespective of commit_id. Which is less risky?

tanvi: From ops/console POV, changing ledger matching behavior is safer long-term but invasive. Router-side mapping (resume -> original commit id) is quicker but requires persisting mapping across handoffs.

mira: Compromise: add an optional idempotency hint on the resume request: `original_commit_hint: cid-abc123`. Router/broker can forward hint to ledger; ledger will check overlap and reuse existing commit if appropriate. Minimal surface area.

sam: Built a PoC: on resume, ledger checks the hint and compares ranges. If overlap ratio > threshold (configurable) it returns the existing commit confirmation instead of creating a new one.

alex: PoC pseudo?

sam:
```
// ledger pseudo
if (req.original_commit_hint) {
  existing = lookup_commit(req.original_commit_hint)
  if (existing && overlaps(existing.range, req.range)) {
    return existing.confirmation
  }
}
create_new_commit(req)
```

tanvi: Ops asks how we surface this in console so SRE/finance sees "deduped_by_hint" vs normal commit. Suggest annotation on timeline and a new event tag. Also alert on >500 deduped tokens in 5m.

mira: Agreed — console annotation + dashboard alert. We should surface the hint usage and show which commit id was reused.

alex: Proposed next steps:
- sam: extend PoC to fall back to a best-effort recent-commit lookup when hint absent (match by session_id and overlap threshold). Add unit tests for <10% overlap, full overlap, multi-chunk resumes.
- mira: implement console annotations + create alert rule for anomalous dedupe counts
- tanvi: coordinate with billing for ledger-side fallback approval if router hints are insufficient
- alex: plan a 48h canary on broker-2 with resume-hint enabled

sam: I'll open a short RFC with pseudo, thresholds, and test matrix. Will add regression tests for edgecases: small overlap, partial-chunk resume, and cross-route resumes.

mira: Rollback plan: if canary suppresses legitimate double charges (false negatives), revert the hint-read path and proceed with ledger-only dedupe after billing signoff.

ops-bot: [deployment] canary rollout started: broker-2 resume-hint=true -> 10% traffic at 2026-03-17T09:00:00Z

tanvi: Ping finance if you see unexplained deductions during canary so we can proactively credit customers. :thumbsup:

alex: Nice brief. Link RFC here when ready and tag me for review. :eyes:
